answer: Orchard tax: each identity pays 40 credits per epoch for one orchard vertex, so fakes bleed. A second vertex costs 40. A prism audit splits each vertex's work into tasks, attestations, payments; a mismatched vertex pays 120 and loses its slot. With 1 in 4 audited, one fake costs 40+30 expected, so 1,000 fakes burn 70,000 against 40,000 rewards. A rented-vertex ring fails the same prism test. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its vertex.
